CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ItemSuscriptor_BuscarPorNombre]
@SearchText VARCHAR(100) = ''
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @SuscriptoresEncontrados TABLE(
		Id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		Suscriptor_Id INT
	)

	INSERT INTO @SuscriptoresEncontrados (Suscriptor_Id)
	SELECT Id FROM Suscriptor WHERE CorreoElectronico LIKE @SearchText AND Activo = 1

	INSERT INTO @SuscriptoresEncontrados (Suscriptor_Id)
	SELECT Id FROM Suscriptor WHERE ISNULL(Nombre, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(ApellidoPaterno, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(ApellidoMaterno, '') LIKE @SearchText AND Activo = 1

	IF(@SearchText = '')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @SuscriptoresEncontrados (Suscriptor_Id)
		SELECT Id FROM Suscriptor WHERE Activo = 1
	END

	SELECT 
		Id,
		ISNULL(ApellidoPaterno, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(ApellidoMaterno, '') + ', ' + ISNULL(Nombre, '') + ' (' + CorreoElectronico + ')' AS NombreSuscriptor
	FROM Suscriptor
		JOIN (
			SELECT Suscriptor_Id FROM @SuscriptoresEncontrados GROUP BY Suscriptor_Id
		) AS [SuscriptoresEncontrados] ON Suscriptor.Id = [SuscriptoresEncontrados].Suscriptor_Id
	ORDER BY ISNULL(ApellidoPaterno, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(ApellidoMaterno, '') + ', ' + ISNULL(Nombre, '') + ' (' + CorreoElectronico + ')'  
	
END
Name: rpt_ItemSuscriptor_BuscarPorNombre
